description: This file defines the EmployeeSalarySearchFilterParams class, which extends a base filter parameters class to handle salary filter parameters for employee records in the OrangeHRM system. It specifies allowed sorting fields and provides getter and setter methods for the employee number filter.

classes.name: EmployeeSalarySearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) for encapsulating salary search filter parameters for employees, including sorting options and employee number filter.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter value, which can be null or an integer.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter value. Accepts null or an integer.
